text:
Alex: Heads-up — Live all-hands cam lost audio feed, presenters on stage but OBS shows red mic. Can @Sam/ops confirm fallback?
StreamBot: Recording stream health degraded — audio channel 1 dropped at 19:03:12.
Sam: Looking. Switching to ISO mic 2 now. Expect ~30s silence while we swap.
Maria: If we lose live audio we should push caption-only for 2-3 mins and start Q&A after we confirm. Can ops tag leadership? @Jon @Priya
Priya: On it. Jon, can you hold the Q&A until we confirm we have at least one clean audio track? If not, we'll do text Q&A in chat.
Jon: Yep, I can delay. Maria — prep a brief announcement to tell attendees we'll be pausing for a moment.
Alex: Posting: "We're briefly pausing while we fix an audio issue. We'll be back in under 2 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: Swapped to iso-mic-2, OBS shows levels but there's a clip on the board; routing to encoder now. ffmpeg I ran: `ffmpeg -f alsa -i hw:2 -ac 2 -ar 48000 -f flv rtmp://encoder/live`
StreamBot: Encoder failover triggered: switched to backup-encoder-3. latency +2s.
Maria: Can we record both ISO tracks to S3? If one is clipped we can salvage.
Sam: Starting simultaneous capture to s3://redwood-recordings/allhands/4287003001/iso2.wav — will keep meta for timestamps.
Priya: Note for follow-ups: capture which encoder + mic used in meeting notes.
Alex: Once stream stable, we'll resume and take the hotseat Q&A. Jon — collect questions from #all-hands-chat and pin top 3.
Jon: Will do. Pinning when stream green.
Maria: Postmortem action: ops to add auto-switch to ISO tracks on audio drop at 0.5s threshold. Filing ticket.
Sam: Ticket created: INF-842 — auto-fallback to ISO mic + encoder health check.
Alex: Thanks all — keeping this thread for final notes and clip requests. :thumbsup:
StreamBot: Recording resumed. final status: healthy, incident duration 00:03:12.
Priya: Follow-up: please attach the clip segments (pre-fail, fail, post-fix) to the notes and flag any speech-to-text regressions.
Alex: Copy that. Also @Product: we'll push the 2 roadmap Qs to next week's doc. Leaving thread open for any clip requests.
Sam: Uploading clips now, ETA ~5m.
Maria: Thanks team.
Alex: Closing once clips are uploaded and ticket INF-842 is linked in the notes.
